title: Zero third-party dependencies — HTTP server, JSON parser and test runner all hand-written
evidence: src/server.cpp (POSIX sockets), src/json.cpp:1-280 (parser), tests/tests.cpp (custom CHECK harness); only SQLite3 + pthreads linked in CMakeLists.txt:9-10

title: SQL-injection-safe and concurrency-guarded persistence
evidence: src/store.cpp:96-100 parameterized INSERT via prepared Statement; mutex_ lock_guard in every BookStore method; test_special_characters_round_trip (tests.cpp:190) asserts a DROP TABLE payload round-trips harmlessly

title: PUT is a full replace (unset optional fields clear year/isbn)
evidence: src/app.cpp:180-185 rebuilds the whole record; tests/tests.cpp:161 asserts isbn becomes null after PUT without isbn
suggestion: Matches TASK.md ('Update a book'); documented behavior, not a defect. Consider PATCH semantics only if partial update is later required.
